plugins.name: code-intelligence
plugins.description: Semantic code intelligence via the symgraph MCP server, launched on-demand by bx.

skills.name: explore-code
skills.description: Use symgraph MCP tools to explore, understand, and safely refactor code. Use whenever you need to locate a symbol, find who calls or references something, trace call paths, assess the blast radius of an edit, find dead code or interface implementations, or build focused context for a coding task. Prefer this over grep/find/ripgrep and over reading whole files when the target is a symbol or a relationship between symbols.

hooks.name: session-start
hooks.description: Verify bx is installed and kick off a background symgraph index if the project has never been indexed.
